## About
Westshore Automotive is a foreign and domestic auto repair shop on S Westshore Blvd in Tampa. Jeff inspects and repairs the cars, and Megan is always willing to answer your questions.
Customers tell us what they value: Jeff takes the time to inspect a vehicle carefully, explains what's wrong, and doesn't push repairs you don't need. One reviewer who came to us from a dealership called the difference "night and day."
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 158 reviews, and we're grateful to every customer who trusts us with their car.

## Services
- Foreign & Domestic Auto Repair: Repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles, from a careful inspection to a clear explanation of what needs fixing.
- Maintenance and repairs: Ongoing maintenance and repair work to keep your vehicle running its best. One customer has trusted Jeff and Megan with every BMW they've owned.
- Oil change: One customer called their oil change quick and efficient.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

A: Yes. We repair foreign and domestic cars, and two customers mention bringing their BMWs to us for maintenance and repairs.
